natural_language_statement:
Let $n>0$, positive arithmetic modulus $p$, nonzero guarded modulus $M$, original class lists $A_0,B_0,C_0$ of lengths at most $n$, and their same strictly increasing normalized witnesses A,B,C be given. Suppose memory satisfies the complete normalization/owner/A-incidence contract and stores the signed A-incidence list $X$ bounded by $U$; original B/C values are also bounded by $U$. All original and normalized arrays, band tables, owner records and full incidence-catalog reservations end before free base $f$. Assume addresses fit words and the complete source-constructor space, word and depth budgets fit. The fixed program constructs the local cover and keys, all three guarded A lifts, balanced physical wanted pairs and every reusable original B/C source bank, while retaining the exact normalized witnesses. If $W$ is its returned physical wanted count and $N_q$ the global-key count, it also establishes

$$M W\le3|X|N_q.$$

It returns the source finish address, meets its stated time and preserves memory below $f$.

This is the complete original-data preprocessing path before shared reporting, with wanted mass bounded by the executed common offset.
